paper.title: EvolvingAgent: Curriculum Self-evolving Agent with Continual World Model for Long-Horizon Tasks
paper.central_claim: EvolvingAgent autonomously updates multimodal experiences and a continual world model via a planner-controller-reflector loop to complete long-horizon Minecraft tasks, improving success rate over baselines.

provenance.notes: actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref null: worker has no access to the claude-kimi routing receipt.

evidence.quote: The LLM-based planner undergoes lightweight fine-tuning using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA)
evidence.support_explanation: The planner is improved by LoRA weight updates on failed-subtask trajectories, not by editing a prompt/skill/memory.

evidence.quote: employs a two-stage CL algorithm to optimize experience selection, which can enable agents to efficiently update the world model without human intervention
evidence.support_explanation: The reflector selects experiences only to drive gradient updates of the world model (Eq. 25, curriculum loss + Fisher regularizer).

evidence.quote: is added to the multimodal experience pool
evidence.support_explanation: The only non-weight retained object is an append-only replay/experience pool, used as training data for the weight updates above (no retrieval-into-prompt use).

evidence.quote: the continual WM for EvolvingAgent can autonomously update multimodal experiences and world knowledge.
evidence.support_explanation: Central claim: autonomous update of experiences and world knowledge (world-model parameters).

signatures.output: updated world-model weights and planner weights
signatures.conditions: online MBRL in Minecraft (MineRL), subtask failure triggers planner finetune

signatures.later_use: controller plans with the updated WM; planner uses finetuned weights
